project.name: CodeAtlas
project.summary: Indexes a repo into a node tree under .atlas/ with deterministic summaries and indexes. Provides resolve and later chunkers/materialization.

nodes.summary: Root: atlas init/index/resolve. Sidecar .atlas/. Later: chunkers, ops, materialize.
Scan workspace, fingerprint diff, build/update nodes+indexes.
Lookup by path/id and return exact content (whole file first).
